anf_compare.notes: No public-domain English of On Pascha exists (Toura 1941; Daly ACW 54 and Witte's German are copyrighted and were not copied). Sense checked against the locked Witte Greek (and, for 1.94, Victor of Capua's Latin as Witte prints it) and the wording of the cited scriptures.

bible_refs.note: The one who does not keep the Passover is cut off from the people.
Whoever eats leaven is cut off; related cut-off formula.
The one who has not eaten has no life.
The destroyer cannot touch those under the blood who have eaten.

pass_a_gloss: And let us see whether the things said by the Savior follow the things said in the pascha. For as there it has been said that the one not having eaten the pascha will be utterly destroyed from his people, so now he says the true sheep, that the one not having eaten of his fleshes does not have life. As there the destroyer cannot touch those who have eaten of the sheep, so now the one who has eaten of the true sheep flees the destroyer.
pass_b_english: And let us see whether what has been said by the Savior follows what was said in the Passover. For as it was said there that the one who has not eaten the Passover shall be utterly destroyed from his people, so now he says of the true sheep that the one who has not eaten of his flesh does not have life. As there the destroyer cannot touch those who have eaten of the sheep, so now the one who has eaten of the true sheep flees the destroyer (Numbers 9:13) (John 6:53) (Exodus 12:23) (Exodus 12:15).
source_text: Καὶ ἴδωμεν|| εἰ ἀκολουθεῖ τοῖς ἐν τῷ πάσχα εἰρημένοις τὰ ὑπὸ τοῦ σ(ωτῆ)ρ(ο)ς λ[ε]λεγμένα. Ὡς γὰρ ἐκεῖ εἴρηται τὸν μὴ φαγόντ[α] τὸ πάσχα ἐξολεθρευθή[σεσθ]αι ἐκ τοῦ λαοῦ αὐτοῦ, κ[αὶ ν]ῦν λέγει τὸ ἀληθὲς πρόβα[τον τ]ὸν μὴ φαγόντα τῶν σαρ[κῶν] αὐτοῦ μὴ ἔχειν ζωήν· ὥ[ς ἐκ]εῖ ὁ ὀλεθρεύων οὐ δύναται τ[ῶ]ν φαγόντων τοῦ προβάτου [θιγεῖ]ν, καὶ νῦν ὁ τοῦ [ἀληθοῦς προβ]άτου φα[γ]ὼν τὸν ὀ[λεθρευτὴν] κατα[φεύγει].
